sizeGuide.head: Size guide

intro.text: Every measurement comes from the graded spec in each tech pack: inches after garment wash, cm rounded to the nearest half. Half measures (chest, waist, hip, leg opening) are laid flat, not doubled.

howToBody.text: Lay a garment you like flat and compare it with the table. Chest is measured pit to pit; body length from the high point of the shoulder to the hem; sleeve from the shoulder seam to the cuff edge. For the pant, waist and hip are laid flat; inseam runs from the crotch seam to the cuff fold.

sizeGuide.sampleNote: All four pieces are cut S–XL. The sample size is M.

intro.text: Terms are being set and will be published here before the first drop. Until then, nothing ships and nothing is charged.

body.text: US shipping first. Rates, carriers and the free-shipping threshold are to be confirmed by the founder.
Pieces are made in small runs. A pre-order shows its ship date on the product page before you commit.
The return window and conditions are to be confirmed by the founder and will be published here.

a.text: Dates are not set. Get on the list on any product page and we'll email you before the drop.

Relaxed, with a slight drop shoulder on the tops; the pant is slim and tapered with a mid rise. Each product page lists the garment measurements for every size, and the size guide has all four tables.
S, M, L and XL across all four pieces. The pant's M fits a 32–34 in waist.
Designed in USA. Imported. The factory is confirmed before launch.

items.q: How do I care for them?

a.text: Each product page carries the care label copy under Care. In short: cold wash, inside out, and keep the cords away from the tumble dryer.
